peers.name: ORACLE CORP
peers.rationale: Diversified enterprise software and cloud infrastructure competitor overlapping with Azure and enterprise application businesses; scale and margin structure comparable.

peers.name: Alphabet Inc.
peers.rationale: Direct cloud infrastructure competitor via Google Cloud, plus productivity software overlap (Workspace vs Microsoft 365); different core ad-driven revenue mix limits full comparability.

peers.name: AMAZON COM INC
peers.rationale: AWS is the primary competitor to Azure in cloud infrastructure; broader e-commerce business is a partial mismatch but cloud segment economics are highly relevant for multiple comparison.

peers.name: Salesforce, Inc.
peers.rationale: Enterprise SaaS pure-play competing in CRM and business applications, overlapping with Microsoft's Dynamics and productivity suite; smaller scale but similar subscription economics.

peers.name: ADOBE INC.
peers.rationale: Software subscription business with high margins and enterprise/creative tools overlap; comparable recurring-revenue model though narrower end-market focus.

peers.name: SAP SE
peers.rationale: Large enterprise software vendor with overlapping ERP and cloud application offerings versus Microsoft's business software; foreign filer but ADR-listed and broadly comparable in model.

peers.name: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP
peers.rationale: Legacy enterprise IT and hybrid cloud/software competitor with overlapping enterprise customer base; larger services mix makes fit partial but still informative on enterprise software multiples.
